title: Great tour guide made visiting the church more meaningful
text: Roberto was such a good guide because it was clear that La Sagrada Familia has special meaning to him as a native of Barcelona. His explanations and descriptions of the features of the architecture and meaning of the elements of the church were deep, meaningful, and reverant of the beauty and spirituality of the structure. Being in a small group was ideal, since we could ask questions and maneuver through the crowds.   This was a really nice way to get more meaningful information about this stunning structure.

title: Symbolism in the Sagrada familia
text: Sagrada Família is not to be missed! Having the Guide enriched my experience as to the symbolism. Roberto was enthusiastic and personable.
author: Christina_Z

title: La Segrata Familia Tour
text: Robert is an excellent guide. He is extremely knowledgeable about all of the architecture and symbolism within La Sagrada Familia. He is extremely excited to share all of his knowledge. I am not an art lover, but he made this interesting and fun for me. I understood all he was saying, stayed engaged in his explanations the whole time, and enjoyed every bit of it. I highly recommend him. Best tour I've had in a long time. Thank you for a great tour Robert!!
author: Sandra_F
